verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS FP&A platform, since some vendors offer on-prem or private deployment, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions self-hosted, on-premises or private deployment of Abacum; it is presented only as a hosted workspace. The 'self-serve' interactive demo is a product walkthrough, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
